draft_basis: source acceptance criterion and predeclared task outcome; not a frozen benchmark threshold

metric_definitions.force_mae: mean absolute per-component force error over all untouched held-out frames
metric_definitions.force_rmse: root mean square per-component force error over all untouched held-out frames
metric_definitions.energy_mae: mean absolute per-atom energy error with documented offset convention
metric_definitions.committee_uncertainty: per-frame spread of independent student force predictions

freeze_requirements: two independent reference runs with immutable input/runtime identities
hidden generation provenance and candidate inaccessibility recorded
agent_results_inspected_at remains null until after freeze
